answer: Each collapsed cluster gets one reef weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. Because of that, an attacker who spins up 130 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 34 times the capital for one share. The ledge report shows the merge explicitly at each tundra. A farm of 1265 identities would post 2378 proofs and burn roughly 24 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
